tweets.text:
The velocity of code changes for engineers this year has 10x’d, quickly moving the bottleneck to code review and testing.

Greptile solves this for the most technically challenging codebases like Nvidia (core CUDA code is reviewed on Greptile), Coinbase, Datadog, OpenClaw and 22,000 more customers.

Many people think the model layer will eat code validation, but I don’t think it will. Code review within organizations is a more context-bound task than an intelligence-bound. The most intelligent AI can be wrong because it breaks an assumption in one API endpoint another service relies on. Large codebases can quickly accumulate a lot of technical debt your coding harness won’t reliably remember every time. Greptile does.

Instead of having a frontier model harness review your code which can quickly cost $20+/review, Greptile does a much better job for much cheaper, leveraging the smartest models when needed but the GLM/Kimi/DeepSeeks when needed to. And it also runs, tests and takes a video of what your change did. 

Over time, organizations treat a 5/5 rated change by Greptile as a guarantee this won’t break anything in prod. And it shows. Their growth has been off the charts.

Incredibly fortunate to partner with this a company. 

Fun fact: Elon once posted Greptile's growth graph with "it's so over" pointing to 2024 to show AI's acceleration.
